# Camp Resource: Nuka Cola Quantum Candy Machine

Enjoy Nuka-Cola Quantum Candy right in your very own C.A.M.P. with this Nuka-Cola Quantum Candy Machine.

- Collects Candy over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Nuka Cola Quantum Candy Machine__

**Produces**

Nuka Quantum Candy

Consuming a candy gives you +2 Charisma for 10 minutes.

Nuka Quantum Candy counts as Candy and Pre-war food for Collect and Consume Score Challenges.

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

24 Nuka Quantum Candy

**Obtainable via**

Season 11 - Nuka World - Rank 34 - Free

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
